_comment: Lighthouse CI. Replaces a lighthouserc.js that was dead three times over:
it used module.exports in a "type": "module" package so it could never
load, every assertion was "warn" so it could never fail, and it set both
`url` and `staticDistDir`. JSON is used here so there is no module system
to get wrong.
RUN THIS AGAINST A DEPLOYED ORIGIN, NEVER LOCALHOST. Measured 2026-07-28,
same commit, desktop preset, 3 runs each:
local `npm run start`  perf 100  TBT   0ms   <- meaningless as a gate
SWA preview origin     perf  97  TBT   0ms
apex bridgingtrust.ai  perf  79  TBT 360ms
A localhost gate scores a perfect 100 while real users get 79. It would
pass forever and detect nothing, which is the failure mode this repo has
produced three times already.
Thresholds are set from the SWA preview measurement -- the application's
real performance on a real deployment -- and every one of them is met
today, so this gate is green on arrival rather than aspirational.
The apex scores 18 performance and 26 best-practices points lower than the
identical build on the SWA origin. That gap is the Cloudflare layer in
front of it, not this codebase, and is tracked in docs/strategy/ROADMAP.md.
Do NOT point these assertions at the apex until that is resolved.
